missing_asos_policy: Output unknown; preserve the previously validated domain.
feature_policy: Existing fourteen weather/time features; external target temperature is a training label only, never an inference feature.
selection: For each reserved spatial group, choose augmented Ridge only if both paired MAE and RMSE decrease on the other three first-winter external groups. Each inner comparison excludes both outer and inner groups from fit and preprocessing. Otherwise use first-winter fourteen-station baseline.
dynamic_reference_pool: Only fourteen competition development RWIS stations. External target measurements are excluded.
